figurative_meaning_en: The wisdom or clever mind of an experienced person; intelligent
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পাকামাথা দেখে সবাই অবাক হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: This is the work of a wise head.
Everyone was amazed by his clever mind.
note: Refers to the shrewd thinking of someone with life experience, often used to praise clever problem-solving.
